_axes: Roblox studs: X = Blender X, Y = up (Blender Z), Z = -Blender Y. 'center' is the middle of each mesh's box, measured from the model origin (bottom centre of the footprint, on the floor).
_front: Front faces Roblox -Z (Blender +Y): CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + faceDirection) points it.
_notes: CLEAN POP PLAZA fence. Replaces Rail x8, Post x60, PostLight x60 in buildPlaza(). Fence line 55 studs from the plaza centre. Per side: posts at u = k * 7.857 for k = -6..6 (13 CleanFence_Post + CleanFence_PostGlow), corners at k = +-7 (CleanFence_Corner + CleanFence_CornerGlow), 14 CleanFence_Rail segments centred at u = (k + 0.5) * 7.857, k = -7..6. All origins on the plaza floor (height 0).

CleanFence_Post.note: white post, sky-blue band, grey seat for the glow cap

CleanFence_Rail.note: one 7.857 segment along X: white top rail (height 2.38), thinner sky-blue lower rail (1.25); ends hide inside the posts

CleanFence_CornerGlow.note: glow orb on the corner post (replaces the gumball the candy corner gets in game)
